cwe_content.cwe: CWE-200,Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

candidate.Reason: The AsgiRequest class is part of the legacy channels.http.AsgiHandler class, which did not correctly separate request scopes in Channels 3.0. This can result in responses being sent to the wrong client, potentially leaking sensitive data such as session identifiers.

The AsgiHandler class is the legacy channels.http.AsgiHandler class that did not correctly separate request scopes in Channels 3.0. This can result in responses being sent to the wrong client, potentially leaking sensitive data such as session identifiers.
